name: YT-DLP
description: Inspect video metadata without downloading media, or download videos and audio from streaming platforms using yt-dlp.

getTranscript.description: Read a video's timestamped transcript and source metadata without downloading media. Returns bounded text, totalCues and nextCue (null at the end); subsequent pages reuse cached captions.
getTranscript.progressive_guidance: Retrieve timestamped video transcripts without downloading media. Results are paginated; continue with nextCue using the same URL and language.

languageCode.description: Optional caption language; omit to select the source language.

startCue.description: Omit for the first page; otherwise pass the previous nextCue unchanged.

getVideoMetadata.description: Inspect a single video's title, description, duration in seconds, chapters, creator, and music metadata (track, artist, album) when provided by the source, without downloading media. Use this for each extracted video URL to identify videos; preserve each result's ID/URL-to-title pairing rather than matching separate lists by position. If a visually transcribed URL fails, copy or re-extract it from the source before assuming the video is unavailable. Missing fields are omitted; music fields are not available for every video. Requires a video URL, not a playlist URL.

downloadVideo.description: Download a single video from a URL.

downloadAudioOnly.description: Download audio-only from a video URL.

downloadPlaylist.description: Download all videos from a playlist URL.

downloadVideoByQuality.description: Download a single video with audio at an exact pixel height (e.g. 1080p), or the best/worst available quality. Separate streams are merged using FFmpeg. An unavailable requested height fails instead of silently downloading a lower resolution.
downloadVideoByQuality.progressive_guidance: Use quality='1080p' for an exact height of 1080 pixels, not '1080' (which yt-dlp would interpret as a format ID). Accepted values are 'best', 'worst', or a positive integer followed by 'p'. Raw yt-dlp format IDs/selectors are not accepted. If a requested height is unavailable, report that rather than choosing a different resolution without the owner's approval. 'best' uses bv*+ba/b; 'worst' uses wv*+wa/w and means lowest quality, not smallest file size. Height requests use bv*[height=H]+ba/b[height=H]. FFmpeg must be available to yt-dlp for merging. The output extension follows the selected media formats; specifying .mp4 in outputPath does not force MP4 or a particular codec.

videoUrl.description: Single video URL; playlist entries are not downloaded.

outputPath.description: Output directory or filename. The actual extension follows the selected media formats.

quality.description: 'best', 'worst', or an exact video height such as '720p', '1080p', or '2160p'. Bare numbers and raw yt-dlp selectors are invalid. No fallback to another height.

downloadSubtitles.description: Download subtitles for a video and return the local subtitle file path. Pass languageCode only when the owner requested a specific language; otherwise omit it so the tool auto-selects from available subtitles.

downloadVideoWithThumbnail.description: Download a video and embed its thumbnail.
